- Dev release preview (seed 7, pseudo benchmark, subject-group split): train 325 rows / development_test 85; defect support train = blur 72, over_exp 36, under_

candidates.description: Reproduce the frozen-protocol reference: trained MobileCLIP2-S0 adapter score head + zero-ROM calibrated measurement defect head, no code change, default params.
candidates.expected_gain: 0 (reference point); expected to land near the historically reported macro-F1 0.424 / PLCC 0.476 within replication noise
candidates.cost_estimate: 1 experiment, 1 forward pass over eval inputs, < 2 min GPU
failure_conditions: Pretrained backbone or adapter checkpoint not found -> FileNotFoundError from common/config resolution
Eval split ambiguity: plugin data.py documents KonIQ (610 eval rows) while the dev preview exposes 85 development_test rows; the measured split must be recorded or the number is not comparable
Reported baseline 0.424/0.476 cannot be attributed if the evaluated split differs from this run's split
Not a new independent acceptance test: the historical benchmark is already exposed
candidates.implementation_goal: No code change. Execute the existing reference method with default config so this run has its own measured reference under the frozen protocol. Dependency checks: MobileCLIP2-S0 pretrained weights and iqa_adapter_v7 checkpoint must resolve (config.pretrained_ckpt()/adapter_ckpt()); if either is missing the method raises FileNotFoundError and must be reported as an infrastructure failure, not a negative result. Prediction: score = clip(adapter_head(features)*100, 0, 100); defects from measure_lib thresholds. Record preds.jsonl, ROM parameter estimate and wall clock in runs/<run_id>/.

candidates.description: New coded method in model_pool/: frozen MobileCLIP2-S0 encoder with cached features + dual heads trained with Huber + pairwise rank + soft-PLCC score loss and class-balanced focal BCE with prior logit adjustment, plus val-only monotone calibration and val-only defect thresholds.
candidates.expected_gain: +0.02 to +0.06 val PLCC/SRCC over the L1-only head (A1) from rank+PLCC loss and monotone calibration; +0.03 to +0.08 supported-class macro-F1 from focal/logit-adjusted defects and val thresholds; 5-class macro-F1 still capped at 0.80 by the 0-support white_balance class
candidates.cost_estimate: 1 coded method (create in model_pool/), ~5 head-training runs on cached 512-d features (seconds-minutes each, <=35 epochs), 1 extra feature extraction pass for 120 flipped rows; ROM ~23.4 MB fp16
failure_conditions: Val PLCC gains < 0.02 over A1 -> loss change not supported; revert to L1/BCE and investigate data instead
Rank loss with margin 0.1 in z units amplifies pseudo-MOS noise -> val SRCC falls relative to A1 while val L1 falls
hflip changes flare/light-source direction cues -> flare per-class F1 drops vs A1 (augmentation not label-preserving for that class)

Verification: supported-class macro-F1 still far below 0.85 (baseline 0.424) and 5-class macro-F1 <= 0.80 by label coverage; PLCC 0.85 unreachable by a single head-only retrain on this pseudo-MOS benchmark if A1/A2 do not move
Isotonic calibration fitted on ~80 val rows overfits -> check split-half val stability before export
Any claim of meeting defect/hardcase gates would require label or class changes, which are prohibited (acceptance thresholds must not be lowered)
If either pretrained or adapter checkpoint is absent the run is an infrastructure failure, not a measured negative
ablations: A1 same code, no augmentation (isolates code/loss effect)
A2 same code + hflip augment (isolates data effect vs A1)
A3 score head only (rank_weight=0, plcc_weight=0, defect head disabled)
A4 fixed 0.5 thresholds + identity calibration vs val-tuned + isotonic
candidates.implementation_goal: ARCHITECTURE: reuse the frozen MobileCLIP2-S0-S0 visual encoder (11.41M params, ~22.8 MB fp16) to produce a 512-d embedding; shared trunk Linear(512,256)+LayerNorm+GELU+Dropout(0.15); score head Linear(256,1) predicting z=(score-50)/25; defect head Linear(256,5) logits for blur/over_exp/under_exp/flare/white_balance. Encoder stays frozen; only trunk+heads are trained (encoder features cached, re-extracted only for augmented rows). LOSS: Huber(delta=0.2) on z + 0.3*pairwise hinge rank loss over in-batch pairs with |delta_score| >= 5 to limit pseudo-MOS label noise + 0.2*(1 - batch PLCC) differentiable correlation term + 1.0*class-balanced focal BCE (gamma=1.5, per-class pos_weight clipped [1,10], prior logit adjustment tau=0.5). TRAINING: AdamW lr 2e-3, weight_decay 1e-2, cosine schedule, batch 64, epochs <= 35 (overrides the file default 60, above the task max_epochs=40), early stop patience 8 on val objective 0.5*val_PLCC + 0.5*val_macroF1 over classes with val positives >= MIN_CLASS_SUPPORT, subject-disjoint 25% val from the deterministic dev split, seed 7. PREDICTION: score = clip(100*(25*z+50)) after a monotone isotonic calibration fitted on val only; per-defect decision thresholds grid-searched on val only; classes with val positives < 5 keep 0.5 and are exported flagged 'unmeasurable'. EXPORT: fp16 state_dict (trunk+heads) + config JSON + preds.jsonl under runs/<run_id>/; ROM = 2 bytes * (visual+head params) ~ 23.4 MB. METRICS: computed only by the independent evaluator; report per-class F1 with support and both supported-class macro and 5-class macro (capped by the 0-support class).

hypotheses: H1: replacing L1-only score regression with Huber + pairwise rank + soft-PLCC loss (frozen encoder, cached features, seed 7) raises val SRCC/PLCC by >= 0.02 over the identical-code L1 head (A1) without touching eval labels.

H2: class-balanced focal BCE with prior logit adjustment raises recall on over_exp/under_exp (36/36 train positives) but cannot raise white_balance F1 above 0 because no positive exists in train or dev_test.
H3: 120 hflip-augmented train rows improve val PLCC and supported-class macro-F1 by >= 0.01 versus identical code on the unaugmented train split (A1 vs A2), unless flare is direction-sensitive.
H4: val-only isotonic calibration raises PLCC more than SRCC (monotone map), so the PLCC-SRCC gap distinguishes monotone error from rank error.

H5: the 5-class defect_macro_f1 gate of 0.85 is mathematically unattainable under current label coverage (white_balance support 0 => ceiling 4/5 = 0.80) regardless of model quality, and flare (3 dev_test positives) is below MIN_CLASS_SUPPORT=5 so it is unmeasurable.
Defect Macro-F1 is dominated by the blur, over_exp, under_exp classes; the frozen eval cannot measure white_balance (0 positives).
Weak classes carried over from feedback: none identified yet.
A frozen MobileCLIP2-S0 encoder with light multi-task heads reaches the ROM budget with headroom while beating the rule baseline on defect F1.
controls: A0 frozen-protocol reproduction (candidate c1) with the same seed/split as A1-A4.
A1 C2 code without any data augmentation -> isolates the loss/architecture change.
A2 C2 code with hflip augmentation -> isolates the data change against A1.
A3 score head only (rank_weight=0, plcc_weight=0, defect head disabled) -> attributes gains to the ranking/PLCC terms.
A4 fixed 0.5 defect thresholds and identity calibration vs val-tuned thresholds and isotonic calibration -> isolates calibration effect.
All variants share the frozen encoder, seed 7, subject-disjoint val split, cached features, and evaluator-computed metrics; eval labels are never used for tuning.
identical frozen eval split and metric code for every candidate
ROM hard constraint checked on every exported model
compare against measure_threshold and the prior best

data_recipe.description: Frozen iqa_agent benchmark: 410 labelled dev rows (train/val, subject-disjoint) + 610-image frozen eval (labels held out of the method's data dir). Label-gap classes are filled offline: local_largemodel/qwen3.8-27b proposes candidate defect labels (scripts/iqa_annotate.py, prompt iqa-prelabel-v1) and every candidate goes through human review before it can enter a dataset version; classes with no measurable support receive severity-matched augmentation (see the data plan in the research report).
data_recipe.isolation: subject-group-disjoint train/val; eval labels never exposed to the method; augmentation never touches the frozen eval in the same protocol version

operations.hypothesis: Horizontal flip is label-preserving for the global quality score and for blur/over_exp/under_exp/white_balance at the severities present in this pool, so 120 flipped train copies regularise the frozen-feature heads and raise val PLCC/SRCC and supported-class macro-F1; flare is monitored as a counter-signal because flare/light-source geometry may be direction-sensitive.

params.note: augment train only; development_test/final_test untouched; count left below the 240 cap to leave headroom for a class-resampling pilot in iteration 2

operations.hypothesis: A local VLM with a fixed defect JSON rubric and min_confidence 0.7 can surface at least one white_balance/flare positive in the existing train pool; because only 4 samples are permitted, this cannot make white_balance measurable against MIN_CLASS_SUPPORT=5 - the only valid outcome is an agreement/calibration probe to decide whether a larger targeted weak-label batch is worth requesting later. Labels are weak only and never treated as ground truth.

params.rubric: fixed defect JSON: {blur,over_exp,under_exp,flare,white_balance} each {present:0|1, severity:0-3, direction:cool|warm|green|magenta for white_balance}
params.usage: train-only auxiliary supervision; never used as test truth

eval_protocol.notes: frozen metric code in algorithm_plugins/iqa/metrics.py (parity-checked against iqa_agent.tools.iqa_model.evaluate); ROM from fp16 params.
